articles.title: Despite Trump's 25% tariff threat, India's exports could grow over 15% in FY27; here's how
articles.summary: Economists Madhavi Arora and Harshal Patel of Emkay said India's relatively strong economic fundamentals and comfortable external balances should help it navigate another round of global trade uncertainty.

articles.title: Bombay HC to hear Tata Trusts plea against Chandrasekaran’s reappointment on Nov 27
articles.summary: The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) and RD Tata Trust (RDTT) have sought a declaration that the September 17 board resolution approving Chandrasekaran’s reappointment was invalid.

articles.title: Traders body urges PM Modi to consider imposing 25% retaliatory tariff on US goods
articles.summary: CTI chairman Brijesh Goyal said the traders’ body was writing to the Prime Minister on Wednesday, November 26, seeking reciprocal action against the US tariff proposal, which has triggered resentment among traders in Delhi and other parts of the country.

articles.title: Tata Trusts move Bombay HC against Tata Sons, seek Rs 65 crore damages; hearing on Friday
articles.summary: Tata Trusts has initiated legal action against Tata Sons over the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran, contending that the board resolution is invalid as it did not secure the required votes.

articles.title: How FTAs, newer markets offer Indian exporters cushion against fresh US tariffs
articles.summary: Tariffs seen to kick in by end-February, exports in most of the current fiscal would be protected.

articles.title: Tata Sons listing row: Showdown looms over November 30 board meet
articles.summary: While the RBI has made it clear that Tata Sons as an upper-layer NBFC must list, there have been instances in the past where RBI has cancelled core investment company licenses

articles.title: Where are gold and silver prices headed in near-term? Check outlook on November 26, 2026
articles.summary: Gold and silver price prediction today: MCX Gold continues to show bearish momentum, reaching new lows for the week after breaking below the prior week’s low.

articles.title: Tata Trusts to move Bombay High Court over Chandra's reappointment, seek ₹65 crore in damages: Report
articles.summary: The Trusts have also sought ₹65 crore in damages and legal validation of their claims

articles.title: No evidence Alice Huang was directed by Chinese intelligence to spy on Jensen Huang, say officials
articles.summary: The briefing, attended by officials from the CIA, FBI, Office of the Director of National Intelligence and National Security Agency, came a day after Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO.

articles.title: RBI brings another 60 tonnes of gold home; 84% reserves now held in India
articles.summary: According to the RBI's latest half-yearly report, India's gold reserves stood at 880.52 metric tonnes at the end of September. Of this, 740.13 metric tonnes, equivalent to 84% of the total, were held within the country.

Top stocks to buy today: Stock recommendations for November 26, 2026 - check list

articles.title: Noel Tata wants revision of Tata Sons’ Nov 30 board meeting agenda: Report
articles.summary: Noel Tata has invoked Article 121B of Tata Sons’ Articles of Association, arguing that the issues flagged by him have not been given due importance.

articles.title: Musk's SpaceX gets US nod for 1 million satellites to power AI data centres in space
'No structural excess capacity in any sector': India pushes back against US tariff allegations
articles.summary: India said on Wednesday that it remained committed to concluding a bilateral trade agreement with the US at the earliest.

articles.title: Travel pushes LRS remittances past $3bn in September
articles.summary: In September, the Liberalised Remittance Scheme witnessed a remarkable increase in outward remittances, reaching a 24-month record of $3.2 billion. The primary catalyst was a 21% rise in travel expenditures.

articles.title: RBI flags rising inflation, says economist on firm footing
articles.summary: In October, India’s economy showcased impressive resilience, bolstered by heightened consumption and credit activities. However, retail inflation climbed to 6.1%, eclipsing the RBI's target as multiple sectors faced price hikes.

articles.title: Abrupt end to Kalyan-raj at Flipkart
articles.summary: On December 4, Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down as CEO of Flipkart after nearly a decade, following clashes with Walmart over financial and listing strategies. An emergency town hall disclosed the unexpected changes, leaving senior executives stunned.

articles.title: 85-year-old wins case to evict son and daughter-in-law from Delhi home
articles.summary: An elderly man owns a flat which he acquired from the Delhi Development Authority in 1980 and converted it into freehold in 2000. His eldest son and daughter-in-law had been living there since their marriage in 2003.

articles.title: India's 10 highest-earning toll plazas collected ₹13,988 crore in five years. Four are on NH-48
articles.summary: Government data in Lok Sabha: India's top 10 toll plazas collected ₹13,988 crore in FY20–FY24. Gujarat's Bharthana led with ₹2,043.81 crore.

articles.title: Lakshmi Venu moves Madras high court for partition of family assets
articles.summary: Lakshmi Venu has filed a petition in the Madras High Court seeking a division of her family's assets, asserting that efforts to amicably settle matters with her father, Venu Srinivasan, have proven unsuccessful.

articles.title: 17% with a deal, 25% without one: Is Trump using tariffs to force India's hand in trade negotiations?
articles.summary: Washington's proposed tariff differential of eight percentage points puts India under pressure to finalise a bilateral trade agreement. While a 17% deal rate could benefit exporters, GTRI warns that tariff relief may come at the cost of unilateral trade concessions.

articles.title: RBI moves 60 tonnes of gold to India in 6 months
articles.summary: Reserve Bank of India shifted 60.1 tonnes of gold to domestic storage, raising domestic holdings to 740.1 tonnes. This transfer reflects a growing preference for domestic gold custody among central banks. As of September 2026, total gold reserves remained at 880.5 tonnes.

articles.title: Tata trust can invest Rs 150 crore in shares
articles.summary: The Maharashtra Charity Commissioner has approved the Tata Social Welfare Trust's proposal to invest an amount of Rs 150 crore.

articles.title: Bulls back in charge, Sensex jumps 1.5k points, hits 84k mark
articles.summary: In a strong show of market resilience on Wednesday, Sensex and Nifty reached nine-month peaks, thanks to vigorous institutional buying. The Sensex alone soared past the 84,000 benchmark as foreign funds continued to pour in.

articles.title: Rupee hits 8-month high, wipes out this year’s losses
articles.summary: The Indian rupee gained 72 paise to close at 92.23 against the US dollar on Wednesday. This appreciation was driven by strong foreign portfolio inflows and lower crude oil prices supporting the currency.

articles.title: Tata Sons plans to take Chandra reappointment to EGM, Noel challenges
articles.summary: Tata Sons is looking to make changes to its articles of association in anticipation of an upcoming initial public offering. Additionally, N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as executive chairman will be proposed at an extraordinary general meeting.

articles.title: ‘One Air India Group:’ New CEO focuses on synergy to cut losses, improve operations
articles.summary: Air India's new CEO, Tewolde Gebremariam, is focusing on a unified approach to improve profitability. He plans to streamline operations between Air India and AI Express while maintaining separate licenses.

articles.title: Trump's 17% tariff offer is a 'bait': Why GTRI wants India to reject a one-sided US trade deal
articles.summary: GTRI has described Washington's proposed 17% tariff rate for India as a calculated bait to extract unilateral trade concessions. With duties of up to 25% looming without a pact, the think tank has urged New Delhi to reject a one-sided trade deal.

articles.title: Rupee recovers FY26 losses, strengthens to 92.16 against dollar on equity rally
articles.summary: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee strengthened against the US dollar, closing at 92.16 after substantial gains. This increase followed significant foreign institutional investments exceeding $12 billion into Indian equities during November.

articles.title: US economy expands at 4.3% annualised rate in Q3, nearly double Q2 growth
articles.summary: The US economy grew at a surprising annualised rate of 4.3% in the third quarter of 2026. This growth was significantly bolstered by stronger consumer spending and robust business investment during that period.

articles.title: 8th pay commission news: BPMS proposes 6% increment, 45-day paternity leave, higher insurance
articles.summary: BPMS has argued that increasing the annual increment rate to 6% would help employees cope with rising living costs and improve their earnings over their careers

articles.title: USTR schedules public comments and hearings in January 2027 on section 301 investigations
articles.summary: US tariff action on India likely to be finalised in the New Year, proposes upto 25% tariff on charges of excess capacity

articles.title: Pharma, steel, solar and ICT: Why Trump has singled out four key Indian manufacturing sectors
articles.summary: The Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) on November 25 identified five areas of concern in India’s economic and industrial policies following an investigation under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974.

articles.title: Beyond crude oil: How gold and precious metals have emerged as India's new imported inflation drivers
articles.summary: Gold and other precious metals are emerging as significant drivers of India's imported inflation, traditionally dominated by food and fuel. A study published in the RBI Bulletin highlights how rising bullion prices are reshaping the country's core inflation dynamics.

articles.title: US proposes at least 17% tariff on Indian imports if trade deal is signed, 25% if no deal is reached
articles.summary: India is among 14 economies facing fresh US tariff proposals, with the Trump administration considering duties of up to 25% on Indian imports. The move could add to challenges for Indian exporters, with detailed tariff rates and product coverage yet to be announced.

articles.title: Cabinet's Rs 11,000 crore manufacturing push: Can India reduce its reliance on Chinese machinery?
articles.summary: The eight-year scheme, spanning FY27 to FY34, aims to strengthen domestic manufacturing capabilities, reduce import dependence and improve the global competitiveness of Indian equipment manufacturers.

articles.title: Air India’s new CEO Tewolde Gebremariam bets on cost discipline, network redesign to drive turnaround
articles.summary: Tewolde Gebremariam said domestic operations at both airlines are consistently recording OTP of over 80%, while long-haul international operations remain an area requiring further improvement.

articles.title: 'The ship has not sailed': Lakshmi Venu still open to an out-of-court settlement, says counsel C Aryama Sundaram
articles.summary: Lakshmi Venu remains open to an out-of-court settlement with her father, Venu Srinivasan, despite moving the Madras High Court. Her counsel, C Aryama Sundaram, said she continues to seek fairness and transparency in the division of family assets.

articles.title: Inside India's Rs 11,000cr bet to end foreign grip on construction, infra equipment
articles.summary: The Indian government has approved an Rs 11,000-crore scheme to bolster the domestic construction equipment manufacturing industry. This initiative aims to reduce reliance on external supply chains while enhancing local production capabilities.
